infoText: {{title}} is the first publication by visual artist {{author}}. This online platform functions as a companion to the printed book. It explores the digital potential offered by augmented reality to unpack the artist's work – his vocabulary, references and obsessions – in an experimental publishing and storytelling attempt.
author: Author: {{author}}
requirements: Requires a WebXR compatible browser and a copy of the book.
scanText: Scan the pages of the printed book to unlock video content and marginalia entries (glossary terms, texts, links).
